rules.statement: An account stated can give rise to a mutual agreement that the sum of Rs. 1,853.12 was due from defendant to plaintiff, creating an implied promise on the part of the defendant to pay this amount.
rules.supporting_quote: "The only question is whether the defendant agreed to pay this amount. It was urged that the ledger account was not balanced at the time the defendant was alleged to have agreed to pay the amount due and that therefore there was no account stated. There is I think no room for this contention for the defendant admitted receiving the letter P 5 dated January 20, 1936, before he met the plaintiff about the dispute."
